title: Theo at DEF CON: winning the Gold Bug puzzle contest with a team of YouTubers and hackers
summary: Theo recaps his DEF CON trip: a hotel-room puzzle marathon, a missed contest deadline and a Team Fortress 2 loss to bad gear. His team won the Gold Bug puzzle contest by combining scripting with collaboration. Mostly a travel and event recap with light lessons on ownership and problem-solving.

principles.text: Own your misses: when you lose on a missed deadline, blame yourself and move on.
principles.quote: it was our fault for not knowing I'm not going to blame anyone for that but ourselves

principles.text: A failed experiment is useful if it rules out a direction and shows you the wrong path.
principles.quote: my scripts were useful not because they solved the problem but because they so well didn't solve the problem that it was clear the path we were going was the wrong way

principles.text: Don't dismiss a laborious solution just because it feels absurd; script it and test it.
principles.quote: I was 100% convinced the solution was not folding all 444 Pages because it made no sense at all
